What every prophet taught

Peace and repair on earth

Seek peace, mend what is broken between people, and never spoil the earth.

Think of the one who steps between two brothers who no longer speak. The Quran says there is no good in much private talk, except the call to charity, kindness or mending things between people. Shuaib, a prophet, wanted only to set things right, as far as he could. God's servants walk gently on the earth and answer rudeness with peace. The books below ask the same. Repair is part of the path.

﴿لَّا خَيْرَ فِى كَثِيرٍ مِّن نَّجْوَىٰهُمْ إِلَّا مَنْ أَمَرَ بِصَدَقَةٍ أَوْ مَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ إِصْلَـٰحٍۭ بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ ۚ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ ٱبْتِغَآءَ مَرْضَاتِ ٱللَّهِ فَسَوْفَ نُؤْتِيهِ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا﴾

Translation of the meaning

No good is there in much of their private conversation, except for those who enjoin charity or that which is right or conciliation between people. And whoever does that seeking means to the approval of Allāh - then We are going to give him a great reward.

Quran · An-Nisa 4:114

﴿قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن كُنتُ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّى وَرَزَقَنِى مِنْهُ رِزْقًا حَسَنًا ۚ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُخَالِفَكُمْ إِلَىٰ مَآ أَنْهَىٰكُمْ عَنْهُ ۚ إِنْ أُرِيدُ إِلَّا ٱلْإِصْلَـٰحَ مَا ٱسْتَطَعْتُ ۚ وَمَا تَوْفِيقِىٓ إِلَّا بِٱللَّهِ ۚ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ أُنِيبُ﴾

Translation of the meaning

He said, "O my people, have you considered: if I am upon clear evidence from my Lord and He has provided me with a good provision from Him...? And I do not intend to differ from you in that which I have forbidden you; I only intend reform as much as I am able. And my success is not but through Allāh. Upon Him I have relied, and to Him I return.

Quran · Hud 11:88

﴿وَلَا تُفْسِدُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بَعْدَ إِصْلَـٰحِهَا وَٱدْعُوهُ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا ۚ إِنَّ رَحْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ قَرِيبٌ مِّنَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And cause not corruption upon the earth after its reformation. And invoke Him in fear and aspiration. Indeed, the mercy of Allāh is near to the doers of good.

Quran · Al-A'raf 7:56

﴿وَعِبَادُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ هَوْنًا وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ ٱلْجَـٰهِلُونَ قَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا﴾

Translation of the meaning

And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily, and when the ignorant address them [harshly], they say [words of] peace,

Quran · Al-Furqan 25:63

You might ask

QuestionIf someone offers peace, do I accept?
AnswerYes. The Quran says that if they lean toward peace, lean toward it too, and put your trust in God.Quran · Al-Anfal 8:61
QuestionHow do I answer someone who hurt me?
AnswerWith what is better, as far as you can. The Quran says good and bad are not equal, and that an enemy may then become a warm friend.Quran · Fussilat 41:34
QuestionHow much is one life worth?
AnswerThe Quran recalls what was written for the Children of Israel: whoever saves one life, it is as if they saved all people.Quran · Al-Ma'idah 5:32

Leave things a little better than you found them, between people and on the earth.
